stages.name: 开模
stages.purpose: Build the carrier form for the spell.

stages.name: 提纯
stages.purpose: Choose the element or ether system.

stages.name: 灌注
stages.purpose: Inject the purified result into the form.

nodes.name: 聚焦
nodes.summary: Focused carrier for compression or reinforcement.

nodes.name: 目标锚定
nodes.summary: Target lock mold for interference or infiltration.

nodes.name: 团块
nodes.summary: Mass mold for contact and infiltration.

nodes.name: 力场外壳
nodes.summary: Field shell mold around a target.

nodes.name: 广域
nodes.summary: High-tier large area or specialist boundary.

nodes.name: 施法过程
nodes.summary: Anchor to an active spell process.

nodes.name: 流层灌注
nodes.summary: Layered flow infusion for unloading impact.

nodes.name: 结构强化
nodes.summary: Infuse a structure with hardness and density.

nodes.name: 多矢量灌注
nodes.summary: Apply several force vectors to one target.

nodes.name: 渗透灌注
nodes.summary: Contact infusion that searches and enters gaps.

nodes.name: 构型灌注
nodes.summary: Infuse material with an editable structure.

nodes.name: 模仿灌注
nodes.summary: No-attribute ratio adjustment from an observed spell.

nodes.name: 矢量场灌注
nodes.summary: Field infusion that redirects incoming forces.

nodes.name: 凝聚灌注
nodes.summary: Condense material into a restraint shell.

nodes.name: 侵入灌注
nodes.summary: Infiltration infusion that follows structural weaknesses.

nodes.name: 破法灌注
nodes.summary: Vector infusion that disrupts an active spell process.

nodes.name: 液体构成
nodes.summary: Essence-level liquid concentration and composition control.

nodes.name: 物质转化
nodes.summary: Essence-level search for common points between materials.

nodes.name: 湿度状态
nodes.summary: Origin-level humidity and liquid state variation.

nodes.name: 动能种子
nodes.summary: Origin-level manufacture of motion and stillness.

nodes.name: 物质种子
nodes.summary: Origin-level material cohesion and separation seed.

nodes.name: 混沌融合
nodes.summary: Origin-level fusion of many functions into one.

nodes.name: 精神引导
nodes.summary: Origin-level guidance of motive force and will.

nodes.name: 束缚释放
nodes.summary: Lock a restraint mold into effect.

nodes.name: 感知释放
nodes.summary: Return sustained vector feedback as perception.

nodes.name: 扰乱释放
nodes.summary: Release conflicting vectors into a target process.

nodes.name: 侵入释放
nodes.summary: Drive the completed structure into target gaps.

nodes.name: 加速释放
nodes.summary: Release sustained acceleration along a guided path.

nodes.name: 构造释放
nodes.summary: Apply an editable material structure to the field.

nodes.name: 偏转释放
nodes.summary: Redirect or rebound forces around the target.

nodes.name: 自维持释放
nodes.summary: Release a structure that keeps operating after formation.

nodes.name: 膨胀外形
nodes.summary: Expand the formed carrier without changing its base mold.

nodes.name: 表面平滑
nodes.summary: Smooth the carrier surface for steadier flow.

nodes.name: 表面凹凸
nodes.summary: Roughen the carrier surface for disruptive contact.

nodes.name: 更大
nodes.summary: Increase carrier scale as a stackable adjustment.

nodes.name: 更小
nodes.summary: Reduce carrier scale as a stackable adjustment.

nodes.name: 保留空间
nodes.summary: Reserve inner space during infusion for later deformation.

nodes.name: 更多灌注
nodes.summary: Add more purified force into the carrier.

nodes.name: 减少灌注
nodes.summary: Use less purified force for a lighter structure.

nodes.name: 高抛投掷
nodes.summary: Release the completed structure with a high arc.

nodes.name: 左弯投掷
nodes.summary: Curve the release path toward the left.

nodes.name: 右弯投掷
nodes.summary: Curve the release path toward the right.

nodes.name: 更快
nodes.summary: Increase release speed as a stackable adjustment.

nodes.name: 更慢
nodes.summary: Reduce release speed as a stackable adjustment.
